items.title: Selar Wants to Make Arctic Cruising Less Like a Cruise
items.why: Small-group expedition operators are candidates for premium travel perk partnerships, so check their appetite for card-benefit tie-ins.
items.summary_ai: Selar is building Arctic expedition trips on a lower-emissions ship, with small groups and local expertise.
